## ⚡ **UPDATE V3.0**

**Join our Discord:** https://discord.gg/6CneN7ex

### 🆕 **New in V3.0**

* 💥 **OP Bring Stuff** – Enhanced “Bring Stuff” system that instantly collects and brings items faster, smoother, and with zero lag!
* ⚙️ Improved overall performance and stability.
* 🔧 Minor bug fixes and optimizations for better gameplay experience.

---

### 🎮 **Previous Features (V2.0)**

* 🗺️ **Reveal FULL MAP** (Inside the Fun Tab)
* 🚑 **Auto Rescue Survivor** (Inside the Teleport Tab)
* 👁️ **ESP ITEMS**
* 💎 **ESP CHEST**

---

### 🚀 **Main Features**

Enhance your gameplay with powerful, optimized, and easy-to-use tools designed for top performance:

🍗 **Auto Eat** – Automatically consumes food when your hunger is low.
📦 **Bring Stuff / OP Bring Stuff** – Instantly brings items or objects near your character with improved precision and power.
⚡ **Speed Walk** – Move faster with smooth and customizable speed control.
🌀 **Teleport (TP)** – Instantly teleport to any location or player.
🧱 **Noclip Mode** – Walk through walls and objects with ease.
🦘 **Infinite Jump** – Jump endlessly without restrictions.
👁️ **ESP System** – See everything around you clearly with advanced visual aids:
  🔹 Player ESP – Locate players instantly.
  🔹 Chest ESP – Highlight all nearby chests.
  🔹 Survivor ESP – Easily find other survivors.
🚑 **Auto Rescue Survivor** – Automatically locates and rescues survivors in danger.
🗺️ **Reveal Full Map** – Instantly uncover the entire map for complete visibility.
🧩 **And More...** – The script is regularly updated with new features, fixes, and performance improvements.

---

### 🎮 **Upcoming Updates**

* 🌲 Auto Chop Tree
* 🌾 Auto Farm
* 🍳 Auto Cook
* 💎 Auto Farm Chest

---

Your support helps keep this project alive — allowing continuous updates, new features, and improvements for everyone.
Thank you for being part of the community! 🙌
